newsitem.title: POLAND: M-Serla to buy Polish paper firm stake.
newsitem.headline: M-Serla to buy Polish paper firm stake.

text.p: Finnish forestry group Metsa-Serla Oy has signed an agreement on buying a stake in Polish paper maker Warszawskie Zaklady Papiernicze SA (WZP), a newspaper reported on Thursday.

The daily Dziennik Prawa i Gospodarki said that under the agreement with National Investment Fund (NFI) No. 8 (Octava), which controls Warsaw-based WZP, Mesta-Serla will buy the Polish paper maker's new share issue.
The Finnish firm would have a 38-percent stake in WZP after the purchase as well as an option to extend its stake to more than 50 percent, the paper said.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
The paper reported that Metsa-Serla plans to invest a total of $10 million in WZP.
NFI Octava is one 15 investment funds created under Poland's mass privatisation programme.
